observations.body: Then Jesus was led up by the Spirit into the wilderness to be tempted by the devil.
observations.label: Text in view

observations.body: The Spirit leads Jesus into the wilderness where fasting and testing follow.
observations.label: Led into testing

observations.body: Spirit, fasting, hunger, and the tester’s first words define the wilderness encounter.
observations.label: Wilderness role

payload.posture: Read Matthew 4:1–3 as its own wilderness scene before relating it to other journeys, memories, or visions.
payload.tension: The passage names divine leading and testing without supplying a full account of divine motive.
payload.title: Jesus led to be tempted
